# AppDimens Games 3.x (3.3.0) — LLM index
# Family: appdimens (hub) · appdimens-dynamic 3.x (Android) · appdimens-kmp 1.x (KMP) · appdimens-games 3.0 (GAMES)
# API vocabulary is IDENTICAL across the family (stems/suffixes/facilitators/builders).
# Math is bit-parity everywhere. Constants: W0=300, H0=533, diag0=611.6305 (family literal,
# true sqrt=611.628155…), perim0=833, ARref=1.78, inv300=1/300, ADJ=0.10/30, K=0.08/30.

## Repository layout
android/ (Gradle build: library*, sample, benchlab) · native/ (C/C++ SDK) · engines/{unity,unreal,godot} · dotnet/ (AppDimens.Games, Tests, dropin/) · tools/ · DOCUMENTATION/ · skills/

## Toolchain
AGP 9.3.1 · Kotlin 2.4.10 · Gradle 9.5.0 (daemon JVM 25) · compileSdk 37 · minSdk 24 · JVM target 17
Compose: compileOnly (runtime+ui), no version pinned in the POM — consumer supplies compose-bom (any version)

## Cross-platform (3.3.0)
Platforms: Windows (incl. Proton/Wine detection), Linux, Steam Deck, macOS, iOS/tvOS, Android, Web (Emscripten), consoles, XR.
Engines: Unity UPM (engines/unity), Unreal Engine 5 plugin (engines/unreal, UMG DPI rule), Godot 4 addon (engines/godot),
.NET netstandard2.0 (dotnet: MonoGame/FNA/Stride/Godot .NET), custom C/C++ (native/), any language via the C ABI.
native/include/appdimens/games.h (header-only C99): adg_surface + adg_metrics_from_surface (scale modes REFERENCE|CONTENT|DPI;
REFERENCE = values are px at the reference resolution, dp tokens return final px: adg_ref_px), adg_viewport_compute
(FIT|FILL|STRETCH|FIT_WIDTH|FIT_HEIGHT|EXPAND|INTEGER), adg_screen_to_design, adg_gl_viewport, adg_native_viewport
(VkViewport/D3D11/D3D12/WebGPU), adg_metal_viewport, adg_scissor, adg_ortho/adg_perspective (per API depth range/NDC Y,
reverse-Z, infinite far, row/column major), adg_fov_for_aspect (HOR_PLUS|VERT_MINUS|HYBRID, max hfov), adg_ortho_half_height,
adg_sensitivity_scale, adg_upscale_ratio/render_size/mip_bias/jitter (FSR1/2/3, DLSS, XeSS, MetalFX, TSR, PSSR, SGSR),
adg_dynres_*, adg_safe_rect, adg_hud_band, adg_min_text_px, adg_min_touch_px, adg_lod_distance, adg_pixel_snap.
C ABI (appdimens_games_api.h): adg_publish*, adg_acquire, adg_read, adg_live_px/ref_px/resolve/dimen, adg_platform().
Docs: DOCUMENTATION/CROSS-PLATFORM.md · GRAPHICS-APIS.md · UPSCALING.md · ENGINES.md · GENRES.md

## Artifacts (version 3.3.0)
io.github.bodenberg:appdimens-games (core) + -auto -density -diagonal -fill -fit -fluid
-interpolated -logarithmic -percent -perimeter -power -resize -units -native + -bom
(+ -custom, unreleased: simplest = one line of typed Kotlin (autocomplete) `CustomScaleStrategy { (width / 360f).coerceIn(0.85f, 1.8f) }` (factor) / `scalingFormula { base * pow(sw / 360f, 0.8f) }` (final value); as text for JSON `scalingFormula("base * pow(sw / 360, 0.8)")` / `64.cdp("…")`;
 own strategies `64f.cdp(Hud)` / `18.csp` / `scalingStrategy("hud") { … }`, JSON shared with every AppDimens platform,
 rules per device class, free-form formulas `expression("…")` / `formula("…")`; C#: `CustomKernels.Cdp(64f, hud)`, `CustomScaleStrategy.Create(s => s.Clamp(s.Width / 360f, 0.85f, 1.8f))`, `64f.Cdp("base * …")`; doc DOCUMENTATION/strategies/custom.md; full guides (Kotlin + C#) DOCUMENTATION/strategies/custom/README.md: quick-start, code-formulas, text-formulas, configuration, json, api-reference, performance, cookbook, troubleshooting; agent notes skills/custom.md)

## Kotlin/Java code API (returns PX)
Int/Float extensions: sdp sdpa sdpi sdpia · hdp hdpa hdpi hdpia · wdp wdpa wdpi wdpia (+Px variants)
Text: ssp sspa sspi sspia · hsp wsp · sem hem wem (fixed)
Inverters (family naming): sdpPh sdpLh sdpPw sdpLw · hdpLw hdpPw · wdpLh wdpPh
Facilitators: Number.sdpRotate / .sdpMode / .sdpQualifier / .sdpScreen
Builder: Number.scaledDp() → DimenScaled (.aspectRatio/.ignoreMultiWindows/.screen/.qualifier/.orientation → .sdp(ctx)|.dp(ctx))
Java facade: DimenSdp.{sdp,sdpa,sdpi,sdpia,hdp,hdpi,wdp,wdpi}(ctx,v), getDimensionInPx/Dp(...), scaled(v), warmupCache()
Escape hatch: Number.toDynamicScaledDp/Px(context, qualifier, inverter, ignoreMultiWindows, applyAspectRatio, customSensitivityK)
Deprecated 2.x gateway names → com.appdimens.games.compat.GamesCompat (migration only)

## Compose API (@get:Composable)
Provider: AppDimensProvider { } · Locals: LocalDimenMetrics, LocalUiModeType · currentDimenMetrics()
Number.sdp/.sdpa/.sdpi/.sdpia : Dp · Number.sdpPx/.sdpaPx/.sdpiPx : Float
hdp/hdpa/hdpi(+Px) · wdp/wdpa/wdpi(+Px) · Text: Number.ssp/.sspi : TextUnit · Number.semPx : Float

## Satellite prefixes (code+compose, suffixes a/i/ia)
psdp phdp pwdp + spaceW/Sw/H(i) · pwsdp · fsdp · asdp (gameplay ⭐) · dgsdp · flsdp · ftsdp ·
isdp · logsdp · prsdp · dsdp

## Resize semantics
Default values auto-adjust on window resize via GameScreen live snapshot.
Suffix `i` = ignoreMultiWindows → invariant: anchored to frozen FULLSCREEN metrics;
under true multi-window returns base value (family parity). `a` = 1+K·ln((max/min)/1.78).

## World layer
Vec2/Vec3 · RectF · ViewportMode{FIT_ALL,FIT_WIDTH,FIT_HEIGHT,STRETCH,CROP} + ViewportTransform
WorldScale.fitPx/fillPx = min/max(winW/designW, winH/designH)·density — identical to FIT_ALL/CROP (native scaleVecFit too)

## Engine wiring (non-Compose)
Activity/Surface/Vulkan: GameScreen.updateFromContext(context[, fullscreen]) per resize/config change.

## Native engines
C++20 header-only: namespace appdimens::games — Metrics::make + updateMetrics + metrics()/invariantMetrics();
math::{scaledDp,scaledArDp,widthDp,heightDp,calculateScaledDp,percentOfAxisDp,powerDp,fluidDp,autoDp,
logarithmicDp,interpolatedDp,diagonalDp,perimeterDp,fitDp,fillDp,densityDp,toPx,scaleVecFit};
render::{viewportRect,glRect,vkViewport,dxViewport,ortho}. Field-compatible with VkViewport/D3D11_VIEWPORT.
Pure C99 single header: c/appdimens_games_c.h (adg_*).
JNI bridge: com.appdimens.games.jni.NativeBridge.{updateMetrics,scaled,scaledAr,scaledInvariant,power,fluid,auto,logarithmic,diagonal,fit,fill,toPx}

ScaledInvariant/Auto/Fluid/Fit/Fill/…) · World.ViewportRect(mode,w,h,dw,dh) · Units.CmToPx…
